等質・等質量・等方散乱・一定衝突率。各roundで全粒子を一度ずつランダムに組み合わせます。初期は±sqrt(3)の二つのビームで、温度の目標は1です。 各seedは総運動量0・総エネルギー固定のmicrocanonical系で、Maxwell/Gammaは大粒子数極限の参照です。 採用した計算法 対の重心速度と相対速度の大きさを保持し、相対速度の方向を球面上で一様に選びます。roundは物理時刻ではなく衝突演算の回数です。 D=<vx²−(vy²+vz²)/2>と置くと、ランダムな相方の平均で重心の異方性が(N−2)/(2(N−1))倍になり、散乱後の相対方向の異方性期待値はゼロになるため、保存した期待減衰率が得られます。 DSMCの衝突部分の教育例です。空間輸送、衝突セル、剛体球の速度依存の衝突選択、実際の輸送係数・流れ場・全seedでの保証は含みません。Bird原著の剛体球条件を再現したとは主張しません。 保存した実測値と判定 表示は丸めています。合否は固定入力の元の公差と丸め前の数値で判定し、全判定が合格した保存結果だけを表示します。 量 / metric実測値 Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Conservation and Maxwell relaxation in a homogeneous DSMC collision component Test conservation and relaxation toward equilibrium through randomized pair collisions of homogeneous Maxwell molecules. Assumptions, units and boundaries Homogeneous, equal masses, isotropic scattering and constant collision rate. Each round randomly matches every particle once. Two initial beams at ±sqrt(3) give target temperature one. Each seed has zero total momentum and fixed total energy: its finite-N equilibrium is microcanonical, while Maxwell/Gamma are large-N references. Adopted numerical method Preserve pair center-of-mass velocity and relative speed, then choose the new relative direction uniformly on the sphere. Rounds count collision operations and are not calibrated physical time. For D=<vx²−(vy²+vz²)/2>, averaging a random partner multiplies the center-of-mass anisotropy by (N−2)/(2(N−1)); isotropic postcollision relative directions contribute zero expected anisotropy. v1,2′=V±∣g∣2n,∣n∣=1v1,2′​=V±2∣g∣​n,∣n∣=1 E[Dr+1]=N−22(N−1)E[Dr]E[Dr+1​]=2(N−1)N−2​E[Dr​] References and measured quantities Use 512/2048/8192 particles and sixteen seeds to check momentum/energy, Maxwell second/fourth moments and the Gamma(3/2,1) energy CDF. Independently check the expected per-round anisotropy factor (N−2)/(2(N−1)). The finite-N component fourth moment is 3−6/(3N−1); distinguish that finite-particle offset from the across-seed sampling uncertainty. Verification limits and failures This is an educational DSMC collision component. No spatial streaming, collision cells, speed-dependent hard-sphere selection, measured transport coefficients/flow fields or every-seed guarantee. Bird’s original hard-sphere conditions are not reproduced. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded.
